# RB-17 Incident triage

Scope: NabaLens internal. Back to the [index](README.md).

| Field                         | Content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Trigger                       | Any metric in breach, A staff or manager report, A failed check after a deploy                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Operator role                 | OPS                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| First checks                  | Record the UTC time, the venue UUID, the screen or route, the account kind (never a name in the ticket) and the deployment in production. Read the dashboard metrics, the last ops_job_runs rows and the cleanup and archive reports. Never ask for media, sign-in links or secrets.                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Steps                         | Classify, highest first: (1) data exposure or cross-account access: escalate to the owner and security contact now and restrict access under the approved incident plan; (2) data loss: stop writes at the narrowest switch and go to RB-12; (3) a journey broken for everyone after a deploy: go to RB-18; (4) one venue, account, job or file: go to the runbook its trigger names (RB-01 to RB-21). If nothing matches, keep the incident open with the owner; never improvise a data change. |
| Narrowest switch              | The one the matched runbook names; see docs/operations/switches.md                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Switches in the catalogue     | none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Data implications             | Triage reads only. It changes no row, object, setting or credential.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Pending delivery              | No consumer delivery is involved.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Readback that proves recovery | The matched runbook's readback passes and the incident record names the runbook, the switch used (or none) and the times.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

## Checks without a database

- unit: `tests/unit/ops-runbooks.test.ts`: Every runbook has the plan §19 fields, and every switch it names exists
- unit: `tests/unit/ops-switches.test.ts`: Every switch in the catalogue exists in source

## Drill

- Description: A tabletop walk: for each trigger metric and report, the index names exactly one runbook, and every switch a runbook names exists in the catalogue.
- Readiness: ready_on_main
- Status: not_exercised
- Environment: an owned isolated stack only, never production or a shared database.
- Evidence: `evidence/b10-02/RB-17/`
